powerOrigins.detail: Like T'Challa, she was enhanced by the Heart-Shaped Herb, which gave her super-soldier-level strength, speed, stamina, senses and healing.
Returned from the Djalia, Wakanda's plane of collective memory, with new powers taught by a griot, such as turning to stone or a flock of birds.

sources.label: Marvel Fandom wiki: Black Panther Vol 6 11

powerOrigins.detail: Trained in hand-to-hand combat by T'Challa and the Dora Milaje, and in acrobatics from a young age.

sources.label: Marvel Fandom wiki: Black Panther Vol 4 20

powerOrigins.detail: A genius inventor who wore her own Panther Habit, with vibranium-cored, adamantium-tipped claws, plus Wakandan gadgets.

abilities.name: Herb-enhanced body
abilities.detail: Peak superhuman strength, speed, stamina, durability, agility, reflexes and healing; she can tear heavy machinery apart barehanded.

abilities.name: Heightened senses
abilities.detail: Sees into ultraviolet and infrared, hears distant sounds and can track people by scent alone.

abilities.name: Genius inventor
abilities.detail: A genius on par with her brother; she builds spy gear, flight equipment and vehicles that fold into a record sleeve.

abilities.name: Martial arts and acrobatics
abilities.detail: A gifted hand-to-hand fighter tutored by T'Challa and the Dora Milaje, and a trained acrobat.

abilities.name: Bird form
abilities.detail: Can turn her body into a flock of black birds or one giant bird.

abilities.name: Stone form
abilities.detail: Turns her body and clothes into flexible stone that gunfire barely dents.

abilities.name: Djalia powers
abilities.detail: Enters Wakanda's plane of memory at will, can bring others along, and has raised an army of dead Wakandan warriors.

abilities.name: Tactician
abilities.detail: A skilled strategist and leader, taught to think two steps ahead of enemies.

feats.text: During Klaw's invasion of Wakanda, picked up the Ebony Blade and killed the Radioactive Man before he could set off a nuclear blast.

sources.label: Marvel Fandom wiki: Black Panther Vol 4 6

feats.text: As the Black Panther, dodged heavy weapons fire even at point-blank range.

sources.label: Marvel Fandom wiki: Black Panther Vol 5 9

feats.text: Back from the Djalia, turned to stone that gunfire barely dented, became a giant bird and recovered fast from energy blasts.

sources.label: Marvel Fandom wiki: Black Panther Vol 6 11

feats.text: Her self-built vibranium gauntlets fired sonic blasts strong enough to briefly stop Killmonger in his Panther Habit.

sources.label: Marvel Cinematic Universe Wiki: Black Panther (film)
Marvel Cinematic Universe Wiki: Shuri (Black Panther)

feats.text: As the new Black Panther, ran along the Sea Leopard's hull with claws and gauntlets, knocking boarding Talokanil warriors into the sea.

sources.label: Marvel Cinematic Universe Wiki: Black Panther: Wakanda Forever
Marvel Cinematic Universe Wiki: Shuri (Black Panther)

feats.text: Survived a jet explosion and a spear wound to beat Namor in a duel, throwing him one-handed and cutting an ankle wing.
